data.name: Band Stage
data.detailed_description: 【BAND STAGE】 is a music-themed dress-up game. In the game, you will be placed on a dazzling and colorful stage, playing wonderful music with different instruments. There is a vast collection of popular golden songs here, covering various styles such as pop, rock, classical, and electronic, fulfilling all your imaginations about music. There are also thousands of fashion items. From delicate makeup to gorgeous hairstyles, from trendy clothes to shining accessories, you can match them as you like. You can not only fully enjoy the fun of music and dress-up, but also make like-minded friends, form a band together, and compete in contests jointly.
